name: faultline
description: Jev-based test impact assessment for CI and coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Understand tests and rank their relevance to a change with Jev.
interface.longDescription: Score actual test source against a cumulative change with Jev, explain proposed selections and costs, and compare frozen evidence with CI outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Use Faultline to configure and inspect this repository’s test source.
Use Faultline to benchmark one PR and save its Jev routing report.
